references.text: The prophecy of a voice in the wilderness preparing the way for the Lord, which can be seen as a prediction of John the Baptist's ministry
Micah prophesies about one who will gather Israel, something that can be interpreted in light of John's role in gathering the people to repentance
A psalm that speaks of Zion and its significance, which can be related to the people's movement toward Jerusalem in connection with John the Baptist's preaching
John the Baptist identifies himself as 'the voice crying out in the wilderness,' directly linked to the prophecy in Isaiah
